skills.wc_vn_shieldbearer: Always on. Attacks aimed at the ally standing behind the shield are weakened.
skills.wc_vn_boar_rusher: Builds momentum while moving. With a clear straight path, charges and turns that momentum into one heavy hit.
skills.wc_vn_grove_druid: After standing still, grows a healing area that pulses. It ends on moving, being pushed, being stunned or being defeated.
skills.wc_vn_hookjaw: Dashes in a straight line toward a distant enemy and hits the first enemy in the way.
skills.wc_vn_prism_scholar: Marks a cell, then fires one beam along its row and a second beam along its column.
skills.wc_vn_tide_caller: Damages enemies in the lane it faces and pushes the first one back through free cells.
skills.wc_vn_soul_jailer: Throws a cage at one enemy. The caged enemy cannot move, attack or cast for a short time. Deals no damage.

traits.undead: All enemies lose armour, more with 4 Undead. The amounts are not set yet.
